items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: a man named Kelly hires me all the time for an Irish party.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Well that was smart. That's a. Sure.

Something to keep. That would keep. And I've got sing-along. I can, I can sit down to the piano and give you words and words. And the same people hire me for certain things. Like for instance, a man named Kelly hires me all the time for an Irish party. John Kelly. John Kelly. And, and we sing, gather around the piano and sing Irish tunes. And I got all of that. I buy, uh, uh, fine albums with Irish tunes, full of Irish tunes. If anyone should ask me for one that I don't know of, hell, I'll go to work and, and,…
Back to that, that was the red carpet club? Yeah, the red carpet.
